decisions.reason: As a close-to-core upholstery fabric with dedicated presentation and no clear negative signal, it remains a low-cost option whose commercial potential still appears solid enough to retain.
Its flame-retardant function fits the firm's contract and performance-textile strengths, so the option value remains high and current evidence does not justify abandonment.

After two years of only limited visibility, its niche wool-blend profile now looks sufficiently revealed as a weaker option, and reallocating resources to stronger core and newer developments is preferable.
Because this 2024 launch has its own page and extends core upholstery and curtain capabilities, uncertainty is still too high to close the option after only one market year.
